set.acceptance: A Go test beside TestMakeTestTimeout in cmd/rhiza/makeupdate_test.go (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestMake') runs make -n on each new target and asserts its go test line carries -trimpath and the budget skip or run regex, that test-api's shards for n=2 partition internal/api's listed tests with no budget test among them, and that test-budgets prints the timings; TestMakeTestTimeout passes with its expected commands updated so make -n test shows the budget tests skipped and no Timing budgets phase (@{01M7EQDFY7GKPF549RAPQE285W}).
set.statement: The Makefile has one target per CI job: test-scripts SHARD=i/n (cmd/rhiza's scripts, budgets skipped), test-api SHARD=i/n (internal/api's top-level tests from go test -list, budgets excluded, split round-robin into an anchored -run regex), test-rest (every other package, budgets skipped), test-budgets (the timing budgets alone, -count=1 -p 1, printing the read-budget timings) and lint (fmt-check, vet, self-check); make test and make check run the full suite but the timing budgets, which only make test-budgets runs.

fields.reasoning: check-is-ci-minus-budgets commits this change set to restating t1-d10-makefile-targets with its targets unchanged plus test-budgets, and check as everything CI runs but the timing budgets, following the owner-approved budgets-opt-in Decision. No new owner words: the target list is t1-d10's, the exception is check-is-ci-minus-budgets'.
fields.statement: Makefile targets: build, install (built in place into `$(PREFIX)`, default `~/bin`, never cp), test, test-budgets, vet, fmt, fmt-check, check, clean and help. `check` = everything CI runs except the timing budgets, which run only in the opt-in `make test-budgets` (CI's budgets job).
